# DRI DDT reproduction inputs

Exact archive members from the uploaded `cpm2-plm(1).zip`, with hashes and archive-member paths in `provenance.json`. The three DDT assembly sources define the reproduction program; DDT.COM is the immutable comparison target. MAC.COM and ASM.COM are retained historical tool candidates. Copyright headers and raw source record padding are preserved.

The archived MAC.COM assembles the three modules. ASM.COM reports errors on the unmodified source. The DDT code itself needs no PL/M compiler. Exact reserved storage is regenerated by compiling an independently archived CP/M 2.0 PIP source with the retained historical compiler/linker in `reproduction/`. The host driver overlays source-emitted DDT bytes on the reconstructed PIP memory and generates the relocation bitmap.

Run from the repository root:

```text
python3 tools/build_ddt_reproduction.py
python3 tools/test_ddt_residue.py
python3 tools/test_ddt_reproduction.py
```

Requirements: Python 3.9+, z80asm 2.1 in Intel mode, z80pack cpmsim, a CP/M 2.2 system disk, an IBM-3740 template, cpmtools (`mkfs.cpm`, `cpmcp`), and Expect. Paths can be overridden with command arguments. Tool binaries, disk images, and source inputs are hashed in the report.

The build now returns 0 only when all 4864 bytes match the reference. All 245 source-uninitialized bytes are explained by compiler-initialized PIP code at independently recorded offsets. The final SHA-256 is `d79890f0a637aee317a255bdac6b27215b1ad4452a1b6da822828bcba5a49ecf`. DDT.COM is opened only after candidate generation; a negative test removes the comparison file and verifies that the same complete output is still generated. No reference bytes fill holes. See `docs/engineering/DDT Reproduction Qualification.md` for the memory model, controls, and the limit on historical chronology.

LICENSE is retained from the repository's existing Digital Research reference collection; the uploaded archive did not supply a separate license file. This retention does not establish additional upstream provenance. These files are not automatically shipped on the production Utilities Disk.

The reproduction source and tool archive have their own provenance under `reproduction/provenance.json`. The exact evidence bundle retains the independent source archive used to extract PIP20.PLM. A rebuild needs no network access.
